command: set +e; echo '===ENTITYOS VM==='; systemctl status entityos-vm.service --no-pager -n 20 2>&1; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MemoryCurrent -p MemoryPeak -p TasksCurrent -p ExecMainPID -p FragmentPath 2>&1; echo '===CONTAINER==='; machinectl list --no-pager 2>&1; echo '===USER SERVICES ALL FRANK==='; systemctl --user list-unit-files --no-pager | grep -Ei 'frank|entity|memory|ram|pflege|immun' | head -100; echo '===PROCESS MATCH==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,rss,pcpu,comm,args --sort=-rss | grep -Ei 'entityos|frank|llama|voice|gespraech|memory' | head -80
